prs.title: [rust-compiler] Fix non-ASCII panic in is_ref_like_name
prs.author: lazerg
prs.body:
## Summary

`is_ref_like_name` checked the first character with `object_name[..1]`, which slices one byte. When a `*Ref` name starts with a multi-byte character like `한글Ref`, that byte cuts into the character and the compiler panics on `.current` access. Reading the first char with `.chars().next()` fixes it, and those names now return `false` like the TS regex does.

Fixes #38023

## How did you test this change?

Added `repro-ref-like-name-non-ascii.js`. It panicked before this change and compiles cleanly after:

```
bash scripts/test-rust-port.sh InferTypes packages/babel-plugin-react-compiler/src/__tests__/fixtures/compiler/repro-ref-like-name-non-ascii.js
```

`yarn snap` (1844 passed), `yarn snap --rust` (1844 passed), `scripts/test-rust-port.sh` (1843 passed) and `cargo fmt --check` are all green locally.

prs.title: View Transitions: update error message classification for Chrome 153
prs.author: sophiebits
prs.body:
Chrome 153 updated the `InvalidStateError` error messages for view transitions ([chromium@bed98a9](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/bed98a9780b75372c1974d8aa0e48f1433082e2f%5E%21/)), e.g. `Transition was aborted because of invalid state. Document hidden`. These now bubble up through `onRecoverableError` whereas previously we suppressed them by exact message.

Don't switch to .startsWith() which would hide every reason; instead just match the unactionable ones (`Document hidden`, `Viewport size changed`, and the reason-less message). Also add the analogous Firefox messages.

`Duplicate view-transition-name` is defined in the Blink enum but doesn't actually ever surface; instead these show up as `Snapshot capture failed` or `Animation start failed`, so add a helpful more helpful message in \_\_DEV\_\_ for those.

Fixes #37669
